coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Avalon at Mission Bay I
record.summary: A residential building at 255 King Street: the Department of Building Inspection filed its new-construction permit in July 2000 (16 stories, 250 units) and recorded it completed on 2004-09-21, while the Assessor roll gives 2003 as year built, 256 units and 19 stories.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8706010 (5,640 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 253 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lots 8706010 and 8706011 and 251 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (way 945538326, 255 King St)); 97% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 86% of the lot.

changes.text: Notes on pages that could not be read are now plain statements, and mapping-process detail is left to the shape's own notes. No change to the record's status or shape.

Thy Spa is shown as open on its own San Francisco page, which could not be opened for a re-check. DataSF lists a business registration at 255 King St Ste C from February 2020 with no end date; a registration does not show the spa operating. No opening date is known.
Avalon at Mission Bay I now uses its Assessor lot lines.

The Avalon at Mission Bay I page no longer cites Arquitectonica's page, which describes a 260-unit building rather than this 256-unit one. No source read names this building's architect, and its name and phase number are Pier & Point's own labels.
Added a photo taken on site on September 28, 2026.
Added a sourced dossier for Avalon at Mission Bay I.

The map notes said this is Phase I of a three-phase AvalonBay complex, about 250 units, built circa 2003, architect Arquitectonica. OpenStreetMap gives only the address, and the Arquitectonica page describes a 260-unit project that matches the third phase, so the notes now carry a dated correction: the Assessor roll for 255 King St shows year built 2003, 256 units and 19 stories, no source read names the architect, and the phase numbering and project name are Pier & Point's own label. The notes no longer state 'first of three phases' as fact. The June 2003 completion month (cited only to Arquitectonica's home page) is now 2003, citing the Assessor roll, and the October 2000 groundbreaking milestone (cited only to SFGate's home page, unverifiable, and with a 16-story claim contradicted by the Assessor's 19 stories) was removed. The Thy Spa listing could not be re-checked because the tenant's site blocks automated fetches, and is unchanged.

open_questions: An AvalonBay leasing flyer (undated) gives 255 King Street as the address of 'Avalon at Mission Bay', but no source read calls it the first of three phases: 'Avalon at Mission Bay I' is this project's own label. Rental-listing pages name 255 King St 'Avalon at Mission Bay' but give conflicting unit counts, and were seen only as search snippets, not opened.

Developer (AvalonBay Communities) and architect not confirmed by any source read; Arquitectonica's 'Avalon Mission Bay' page (407,000 SF, 260 units) gives no address or year and may describe a different phase.
The permit completed date (2004-09-21) and the Assessor year built (2003) disagree by about a year; the permit date is a closeout record. No opening month found.
The permit is recorded under block 8706 lot 001, a different lot from the Assessor parcel 8706010; the relationship (condominium or subdivision lots) is not explained in any source read.

Thy Spa (255 King St Ste C) is shown as open on its own San Francisco page, which could not be read (access refused on 2026-10-12), so it has not been re-read. A DataSF business registration exists for Thy Spa Us LLC at that address from 2020-02-13 with no end date; a registration is not evidence of an operating spa. No opening date is known.
